# Browser dependencies

These exact files are included so the example projects can render without a CDN. Versions, origins and SHA-256 values are in manifest.json.

- GSAP 3.14.2: Webflow, Standard No Charge License (gsap-3.14.2/LICENSE.txt); not relicensed under Apache-2.0.
- Three.js 0.128.0, 0.147.0, 0.170.0 and 0.181.2: MIT; each version retains its LICENSE. The TTF loader dependency retains its embedded opentype.js notices.
- Clipper 6.4.2: retain the Boost and MIT notices embedded in clipper.js.
- d3-delaunay 6.0.4: ISC; LICENSE is included.
- Inter, Gelasio, DM Sans, Libre Baskerville and Libre Franklin: SIL OFL; unmodified font binaries and each family's OFL text are included. Stylesheet URLs were made relative.

Source code and reference-film licenses remain separate from these dependency licenses. Node, browser, FFmpeg and Python execution tools are installed separately; this directory is not an offline OS/toolchain installer.
